purpose: Extend the already-frozen shared metric to one additional live campaign without changing metric semantics.

admitted_campaign.parent_residual: replicate V21 unchanged over 21 fresh-process pairs using V20 frozen CPU criterion
admitted_campaign.credit_rule: 1 iff V22 completes its predeclared 21-pair gate with exact protected state/root parity and yields a verifier-backed terminal performance classification under the workflow's frozen rule; 0 on execution failure, parity regression, or missing classification
admitted_campaign.verification_boundary: 21 fresh-process alternating stock/Crystal pairs; unchanged V21 implementation; classification rule frozen in candidate workflow before execution outcome
admitted_campaign.workflow_acceptance_rule: WARRANTED_PERFORMANCE iff median apply CPU ratio > 1, >=14/21 pairs favor Crystal, bootstrap 95% lower bound > 1; NARROWS iff median > 1 otherwise; REJECTS_DIRECTION iff median <= 1

anti_leakage: no performance direction required for atom credit; a verifier-backed negative classification is still a sharpened residual
any protected semantic regression invalidates credit
